findings.message: handoff/README.md H1 section does not follow task 6.2: it lacks the required opening sentence "Apply `H1-glossary-track-end.patch` of the archived change `fix-day-track-handle-overlap-and-end-of-day` first; the command below does it when it is not applied yet.", and its Apply line is only `git apply openspec/changes/fix-day-track-drag-continuity-and-smoothness/handoff/H1-glossary-handle-drag.patch` instead of the exact compound command `{ git apply --check --reverse …/H1-glossary-track-end.patch 2>/dev/null || git apply …/H1-glossary-track-end.patch; } && git apply --unidiff-zero …/H1-glossary-handle-drag.patch`; the task's check `grep -cE '^- \*\*Apply:\*\*.*H1-glossary-track-end\.patch.*H1-glossary-handle-drag\.patch'` would print 0, yet task 6.2 is ticked.

H1-glossary-handle-drag.patch was generated with 3 lines of context (hunk `@@ -3,8 +3,8 @@`), but task 6.2 requires a context-free patch (`git diff -U0`). Its context includes the 'Time selection … clamped to the reference day.' line, which the archived H1-glossary-track-end.patch rewrites to '… clamped between the start of the reference day and the track end', so in the required order (track-end patch first) this patch no longer applies and the task's scratch verification fails.

src/test/features/time_selection/steps/time_selection_drag_unit.steps.tsx is 218 lines; task 5.1 says 'If the steps file passes 200 lines, move helpers into `steps/dragSteps.ts`' and the tasks preamble says 'every file stays under 200 lines' (process-invariants: 'Target 100–200 lines per file'). The helper file is also named dragSteps.tsx, not the dragSteps.ts the task names.

time_selection_drag_e2e.feature uses 'the screen is 375 by 400 px' for 'A drag continues when the pointer leaves the track' and 'A drag past the right end pins the track end', but task 5.2 specifies 375 × 300 px, and its fallback when the points don't fit is to 'lower the offset here and in the spec scenario together', not to enlarge the viewport.

useDayTrackTouchFallback.ts:92-94 passes an inline `{ passive: true }` listener options literal while the non-passive option is a named constant (TRACK_TOUCH_MOVE_LISTENER_OPTIONS in constants/timeSelection.ts); code-style.md requires configuration values to live in src/constants ('Is any value repeated in 2+ places? → Must be a constant'), so a touchstart options constant belongs next to it.

findings.message: Handoff H1 patch openspec/changes/fix-day-track-drag-continuity-and-smoothness/handoff/H1-glossary-handle-drag.patch is not a zero-context patch: tasks.md 6.2 says 'make this patch without context, against the file as committed: `git diff -U0 -- docs/glossary/time-selection.md`', but the hunk is `@@ -5,4 +5,4 @@` with context lines for Reference day (before) and Time selection (after). The archived H1-glossary-track-end.patch rewrites that Time selection line ('clamped to the reference day' -> 'clamped between the start of the reference day and the track end'), so after the required track-end-first order the context no longer matches and the ticked 6.2 scratch check (`git apply <track-end> && git apply --unidiff-zero <handle-drag>`) cannot pass. Regenerate the patch with -U0 (a hunk like `@@ -6,2 +6,2 @@` with only the -/+ lines).

handoff/README.md H1 **Apply** line is not the mandated command: tasks.md 6.2 requires 'exactly this command' ending in `git apply --unidiff-zero openspec/changes/fix-day-track-drag-continuity-and-smoothness/handoff/H1-glossary-handle-drag.patch`, but the README has `git apply -C0 --unidiff-zero ...`. The -C0 works around the context lines of finding 1; fix the patch and restore the exact command.

time_selection_drag_e2e.feature: task 5.2 specifies the outline 'A drag continues when the pointer leaves the track' 'at 375 × 300 px' and says 'if they do not fit, lower the offset here and in the spec scenario together', but the scenario (and 'A drag past the right end pins the track end') uses 'the screen is 375 by 400 px for the locations'. Use 375 × 300 and adjust the offset (with the spec scenario) if the points do not fit.

findings.message: The E2E scenario 'A drag continues when the pointer leaves the track' (packages/client/src/test/features/time_selection/time_selection_drag_e2e.feature:13) drags '110 px below it', but the spec scenario still says 'moves the pointer to three quarters of the track's width while 120 px below the track' (openspec/changes/fix-day-track-drag-continuity-and-smoothness/specs/time-selection/spec.md:130), as do the unit feature (time_selection_drag_unit.feature:11) and OFFSET_BELOW_PX = 120 in dragSteps.ts. Task 5.2 allows a lower offset only together with the spec: 'if they do not fit, lower the offset here and in the spec scenario together.' Either set the E2E back to 120 px, or change the spec scenario (and the matching unit feature and constant) to 110 px.

Unit BDD 'The dragged handle follows the pointer between track steps' checks the New York handle with world.trackOf(city).fraction (packages/client/src/test/features/time_selection/steps/time_selection_drag_unit.steps.tsx:111-118). createDragDriver renders only the Almaty DayTrack, so no drawn handle is checked for New York. Task 5.1 requires 'the handle is read from the rendered [data-day-track-handle] with the current presented track, never from world.trackOf alone'. Render the New York DayTrack too, re-rendered with the current track, and assert its [data-day-track-handle] style.left.

stop.question: Task 6.2 requires H1-glossary-handle-drag.patch to be context-free (git diff -U0, applied with --unidiff-zero). The stage check runs plain `git apply --check` on every handoff patch, and git rejects a zero-context patch without --unidiff-zero, so both cannot hold (the committed patch is now -U0 and fails that check). A patch with context passes the check, but its trailing context line (Time selection ... clamped to the reference day.) is rewritten by the archived track-end patch, so it fails in the order task 6.2 mandates. Which wins? Other judge findings are fixed: E2E back to 120 px at 375x300 (full suite not yet run), New York handle asserted from a rendered DayTrack, touchstart options constant already exists.
options: Keep the -U0 patch as task 6.2 says and add --unidiff-zero to the stage's git apply --check
Use a patch with context that passes plain git apply --check, and change task 6.2 and the apply order accordingly
